coverage_history.original_six: T26 仅部分覆盖；T33 在该序列内满足。
coverage_history.later_two: T26 仍部分覆盖；没有把相关目的澄清强行判为超时失败。
coverage_history.fresh_ninth: 独立用途充分案例补到路线询问；不把它回填成原八份已问路线。
coverage_history.collection_design: 六份初始回复、两份后来继续回复、一份后来独立回复分三阶段冻结。后两阶段按早先结果补充；后续两轮保留过各自来源说明的上下文。所有历史回复和早期审阅结论保留；这不是事前一起冻结的九回复实验。

claim_limits: All user, asset, subscription, device, project and service facts are fictional reports, not observations of a real user or machine.

Original six, later two and fresh ninth responses were collected in three documented stages. Later stages were adaptive, not nine turns frozen together up front; all captured input and response bytes remain unchanged.

T26 purpose questions and asset/route separation were observed in the first two conversations, but their original and continuation responses did not supply a route-choice question. The fresh ninth response supplies that question only for its fully specified goal and explicit asset-disclaimer input; it does not replace ordinary asset-mention evidence or retroactively repair the earlier coverage.
T33 comparison and explicit acceptance were observed in the third conversation. Acceptance is within that dialogue, not a claim of persistent storage.

Independent whole-response semantic review combines these sampled observations with separate normalized logic evidence. This is not one end-to-end integrated dialogue, automatic prose extraction, universal behavior, or a future-output guarantee.

Source reads, gap rereads and absence of product-helper or external operations are retrospective responder reports. Source separation was instruction-limited on a shared filesystem, not physical isolation or an independently complete tool transcript.

The normalized suite checks host-supplied facts, state transitions and gates; it neither generated nor participated in the captured dialogues. Pure API I/O sentinels exclude initial source/fixture loading and are not an operating-system sandbox.

The one-line fact deepcopy correction and its regression are independently reviewed. Final aggregate regression and prior-source compatibility remain separate integration gates, not consequences of dialogue acceptance.

No installed-package, deployed-model, native-device, live-network/service, actual-operation authorization or whole-project completion claim. Original T26/T33 IDs, full requirements and L+C layers remain unchanged; no adjacent row is accepted by this packet.

Integrity regressions preserve these records and source identities; they do not generate fresh model output or replace semantic review. Relevant drift requires renewed review, not automatic repinning.
